{{Top|leg}}
A '''spy shuttle''' was a [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] employed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Defense Force]] circa [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. While onboard a spy [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] en route to the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]] in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was yanked from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by a [[Yevetha]]n ship. His escort [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were disabled and Solo was taken prisoner by the Yevetha, who wanted to use him as political leverage on his wife and [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].
